answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake locked to one cipher keypair, earned only through verified work over weeks, before it can trade. Like boats queuing at a single jetty, each identity gets one berth: creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes and completing a thousand histories of real work. A haven for honest traders emerges because fakes become too costly to mass-produce, and cheaters forfeit their stake when caught.
